_note: COMPLETE PANEL-SET ANATOMY OF A HOTEL / MULTI-BUILDING PLANT (surveyed live from all 69 compiled panels of one production plant; plant id masked NNNNN, buildings genericized to Bygg A/B/C, meeting-room names to Rom 1-3). This is the normative reference for the panel types the supermarket corpus does not cover: navigation-hub Oversikt, hotel Ventilasjon with satellites (kurvestyring/Ur/Kurver/Reserve), Varme, Tappevann, Varme+Tappevann combos, Romkontroll floor plans and mini status panels. Briefing section 7d is the prose version.

plant_profile.vertical: hotel, three buildings (Bygg A/B/C), 8 ventilation systems 360.001-360.008, heating 320.001-2, tap water 310.001, comfort cooling 370.001, room control per floor
plant_profile.size_standard: 1280x1024 for everything EXCEPT the Romkontroll floor plans, which are 1400x750 (newer additions)

driver_ecosystems.BACNET3 (Swegon vent aggregates): CamelCase point names in alias: 'ActOpMode [ Operating mode ]', 'SplyFanCmdSt [ Supply fan cmd ]', 'TmpSpvCoSpvHtg [ Setpoint temp ]'
driver_ecosystems.Sauter-style: alias H'Sys320001'TFl402 [ 320.001 -RT402 Tur ] on the combo panels
driver_ecosystems.navigation objects: driver_id = the TARGET PANEL's numeric id from the panel list (e.g. '6', '39', '60') - NOT a driver parameter

organization_conventions.visibility: Only the main Oversikt has visible=1. EVERY other panel is visible=4 (hidden from the top menu, reached only through navigation objects). Separator pseudo-panels named '----- Ventilasjon -----' / '-----' (0 objects, blank_nav.png background) group the list in the panel picker.
organization_conventions.satellites_per_vent_system: each 360.NNN system gets: the main panel + '360.NNN kurvestyring' (or 'Kurver') + '360.NNN Ur' (3 nav buttons only) + '360.NNN Reserve 1' and 'Reserve 2' (EMPTY 0-object placeholder panels - reserved slots ARE house style)
organization_conventions.xml_only: Ur / Kurver / Reserve / separators / Teknisk on this plant exist only in the legacy XML store (iw_load_ctrls without format=json); the JSON store returns empty for them
organization_conventions.shared_library_images: backgrounds are frequently referenced from another plant's folder (a template library plant), e.g. blank_nav.png, IBT-varmeanlegg.png, 4p_kurve.png

navigation_model.principle: The plant is ONE visible menu panel + sub_page buttons everywhere else. A sub_page/previous_page object's driver_id holds the numeric panel id it navigates to.
navigation_model.oversikt_hub: icon tiles sub_page_360_ventilation / sub_page_565_room_control / sub_page_320_heating_plant (120x80), one per target panel, in a column grid
navigation_model.satellite_nav: each satellite panel carries previous_page_4 (80x40) top-left back to its parent, and/or sub_page_4 pills (80x40, also 74x28/72x28/32x32) to siblings
navigation_model.bottom_nav_triple: sub_page_link_btn_left + sub_page_link_btn_home + sub_page_link_btn_right (38x38) in a row at y~649, x~1221-1293 on 1280x1024 panels - prev/home/next paging between systems
navigation_model.kurver_button: sub_page_80_24_kurver_btn (80x24) in the right column of Varme links to the curve panel

per_section_rows: section title: label_12px_bold ('Ventilasjon', 'Varme-/kjoleanlegg', 'Romkontroll') at the section top
building label: label_12px_bold per column ('Bygg A', 'Bygg B') 20 px below
icon tile: sub_page_XXX 120x80 per column (driver_id = target panel id)
caption: header_grey75 116x30 under each tile with the target's full name ('360.001 Hotellrom 1-9 etg')
oversikt_nav_hub.sections_top_to_bottom: Ventilasjon (8 tiles, y85) -> Varme-/kjoleanlegg (3 tiles incl. 150x120 Tappevann tile, y227) -> Kjol og frys (1 tile 'Oversikt Kjokken', y361) -> Romkontroll (4 floor-plan tiles, y511) -> footnote label_9px_norm lines at y656+
oversikt_nav_hub.live_values: the hub itself links nothing except the tiles - 16 of 46 objects are the tiles carrying panel-id driver_ids

sub_page_4 pills right side to the serving vent system + sub_page_V5 80x40 bottom-right
